'''Mrs. Jensen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[moisture farmer]] and the neighbor and friend of [[Ariq Joanson]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with her husband. He didn't support Joanson's plan to make peace with jawas and tuskens.
